_comment: Baseline of status-✓ COMPAT rows tolerated by the CI gate (packages/conformance/src/audit-gate.ts), from both audit.ts worklists: high-risk unverified rows (score >= 2, ✓ status, no oracle/test evidence and no explicit exception) and unit-backed evidence-tier gaps (✓ status, automation unit-backed, risk 'unobserved' or 'cited-not-replayed' — the claim outruns the observation record; the messaging#* / messaging-admin#* entries are this class). The gate fails when a PR introduces a row NOT in this list. To pay down debt: add evidence, classify an exception in packages/conformance/registry/*.ts, or downgrade the status, then remove its id here. Regenerate with `bun run packages/conformance/src/audit-gate.ts --update`.
